uiSetup.adaptiveInfoUC: Difficoltà Adattiva: più gruppi imperiali sconfiggi, più l'Impero cercherà di fermarti, ma migliori saranno le ricompense.

uiMainApp.eliteUpgradeMsgUC: Uno o più schieramenti <color="green">Regolari</color> sono stati migloiorati a gruppo <color="red">Elite</color>.
uiMainApp.eliteDowngradeMsgUC: Uno o più schieramenti <color="red">Elite</color> sono stati declassati a gruppo <color="green">Regolari</color>.
uiMainApp.restoreErrorMsgUC: <color="red">Si è verificato un errore durante il caricamento della sessione.</color>
uiMainApp.fame1UC:
Se completi la missione prima della fine del round 7, sarai in grado di guadagnare il numero di ricompense visualizzato.

Dopo la missione, le ricompense possono essere utilizzate per:
uiMainApp.fameItem1UC: • Pesca una carta Oggetto aggiuntiva dal mazzo di tua scelta durante la fase delle Migliorie Ribelli (costo: 1 Ricompensa per carta)..
uiMainApp.fameItem2UC: • Pesca una carta Missione Secondaria aggiuntiva e mettila in gioco come missione attiva (costo: 2 Ricompense per carta, massimo 2 carte).
uiMainApp.fame2UC: Non appena il contatore dei round raggiunge 8, le ricompense della missione vengono impostate a 0.
uiMainApp.reinforceWarningUC: Non ci sono gruppi nemici da rinforzare o l'attuale minaccia è troppo poca per rinforzare un gruppo.
uiMainApp.deploymentWarningUC: Non ci sono gruppi nemici da schierare o l'attuale minaccia è troppo poca per schierare un gruppo.
uiMainApp.noRandomMatchesUC: Nessun gruppo corrispondente che costa {d} o meno.

sagaMainApp.deployMessageUC: Schierare il seguente Gruppo di Schieramento
sagaMainApp.noDPWarningUC: ATTENZIONE - Nessun punto di schieramento attivo trovato.
sagaMainApp.groupsReadyUC: I seguenti gruppi sono diventati Pronti
sagaMainApp.groupsExhaustUC: I seguenti gruppi sono diventati Esauriti
sagaMainApp.medpacInfoUC:
Un eroe può usare un Medpac quando esegue un'Azione Riposo, e un alleato può usare un Medpac come Azione.

Quando una miniatura usa un Medpac, recupera 5 {H}. I medpac possono essere trovati nelle casse.
sagaMainApp.cannotDefeatUC: Questo gruppo non può essere sconfitto.
sagaMainApp.optionalDeployPickDpUC: Ora clicca un punto di schieramento sulla mappa:
sagaMainApp.optionalDeployNoGroupsUC: Nessun gruppo disponibile per lo schieramento opzionale.
sagaMainApp.optionalTacticalAnnounceUC: {0} si schiera in {1}. Piazza le sue figurine sul punto di schieramento.

uiCampaign.threatInfoUC: Il livello di minaccia è uguale all'ultima missione giocata.
uiCampaign.campaignDescriptionUC: Intraprendi una campagna nuova o esistente attraverso la galassia.
uiCampaign.sagaDescriptionUC: Gioca una singola missione narrativa con una presentazione della mappa in 3D.
uiCampaign.classicDescriptionUC: Gioca una singola missione usando la guida della tua campagna e nessuna mappa 3D.
uiCampaign.agendaImperialUC: L'Impero ti vede come una minaccia che vale la pena fermare. Pesca una carta dal Mazzo delle Missioni Imperiali e mettila in gioco. Se è una missione forzata, giocala immediatamente. Se è una missione secondaria, diventa una missione secondaria attiva.
uiCampaign.agendaRebelUC: L'Impero usa le sue risorse altrove. Non accade nulla.

uiTacticalAI.apTreeHunter: Focus zone: the area the rebels' current mission objective points at – that is where the hunter hunts. ? Attack point available? Hero INSIDE the focus zone OR moving into it in range and clear line of sight? → attack him (several candidates? → the one with the higher threat value; EXPLAIN shows it). No zone hero reachable, but focus target in range + clear line of sight? → attack the focus target. No attack possible? → this point becomes movement: move up to {0} spaces toward the focus zone resp. the zone hero. ? Attack point(s) spent? Then this point is movement: move up to {0} spaces toward the focus zone resp. the zone hero. The hunter's creed: a hero OUTSIDE the focus zone who is not moving into it is not your target – ignore him, even when he blocks your path. Only whoever attacks YOU may reap your shot back this round; nobody is pursued for it.
uiTacticalAI.apTreeOfficerHunter: ? Attack point available? Order possible? → Which other Imperial figure in reach repositions up to 2 spaces, and where to: toward the focus zone, away from it, or sideways? – the Order spends your attack point and overrides the commanded figure's doctrine. No Order? → Zone hero (working the mission objective inside the focus zone) in range + clear line of sight? → attack yourself; otherwise the focus target, if shootable. Neither Order nor attack possible? → this point becomes movement: hold position, or move up to {0} spaces toward the focus zone. ? Attack point(s) spent? Then this point is movement: hold position, or move up to {0} spaces.
uiTacticalAI.apTreeOfficerKeepHunter: ? Attack point available? Order possible? → Which other Imperial figure in reach repositions up to 2 spaces, and where to: toward the focus zone, away from it, or sideways? – the Order spends your attack point and overrides the commanded figure's doctrine. No emergency? → do not attack on your own. A self-initiated attack is allowed only in one of these emergencies: he is under fire; a hero stands directly beside him; the mission objective is acutely threatened and only he can intervene; or he is the last surviving Imperial group – then he may fight as his doctrine allows. Without an emergency: give your Order, stay in cover behind the group you gave the order to, and do not drift away from it – never move farther from your nearest Imperial ally than it is right now; if no cover can be held, take one step back – never one forward. Neither Order nor attack possible? → this point becomes movement: hold position, or move up to {0} spaces toward the focus zone – never moving farther from your nearest Imperial ally than it is right now. ? Attack point(s) spent? Then this point is movement: hold position, or move up to {0} spaces – never moving farther from your nearest Imperial ally than it is right now.

Neither Order nor attack possible? → this point becomes movement: hold position, or move up to {0} spaces. ? Attack point(s) spent? Movement → which other Imperial figure in reach repositions up to 2 spaces, and where to: toward the focus zone, away from it, or sideways? – the Order spends your attack point and overrides the commanded figure's doctrine. No emergency? → do not attack on your own. A self-initiated attack is allowed only in one of these emergencies: he is under fire; a hero stands directly beside him; the mission objective is acutely threatened and only he can intervene; or he is the last surviving Imperial group – then he may fight as his doctrine allows. Without an emergency: give your Order, stay in cover behind the group you gave the order to, and do not drift away from it – never move farther from your nearest Imperial ally than it is right now; if no cover can be held, take one step back – never one forward. Neither Order nor attack possible? → this point becomes movement: hold position, or move up to {0} spaces – never moving farther from your nearest Imperial ally than it is right now. ? Attack point(s) spent? Then this point is movement: hold position, or move up to {0} spaces – never moving farther from your nearest Imperial ally than it is right now.
uiTacticalAI.ordFocusFokuszone: — focus zone: {0} hunts the hero at the mission objective, not the nearest one
uiTacticalAI.ordExplainFokuszone: Focus zone: {0} works the mission objective – {1} (hunter, tier 3+) follows into the zone resp. the hero moving there and leaves heroes outside alone; whoever attacks {1} may expect one shot back.
uiTacticalAI.docGuard: Guard (hold the zone, deny the paths, never be lured out)
uiTacticalAI.docAmbusher: Ambush (stay unseen until the first shot)
uiTacticalAI.overlordFallback: IA Tattica - Overlord: il feed del mondo tattico non è ancora attivo: la pianificazione segue le regole di riferimento.
uiTacticalAI.specialAsPrinted: Special action: execute exactly as printed on the card.
uiTacticalAI.restLine: Leave this action unperformed: Imperial figures have no Endurance value, so resting would gain them nothing. The figure stays put.
uiTacticalAI.interactLine: Interact: perform an interaction the mission allows (e.g. open an adjacent door, unless the mission has locked it).
uiTacticalAI.focusWounded: he is wounded - finish him first (table damage tracker)
uiTacticalAI.focusFirepower: highest firepower among the remaining heroes (attack dice, then health)
uiTacticalAI.ordAbilitiesLane: Printed special abilities are the Imperium’s call: the attack action may include them exactly as printed (Rules Reference) – the Tactical AI proposes movement and attack only, because deciding “may” abilities needs the board it never sees.
uiTacticalAI.ordFocusDetail: Focus score: {0} = {1} ({2}); basis: {3}; next: {4} — printed hero-card values, wound marks and the mission goal are the only inputs.
uiTacticalAI.ordFocusBasisChip: regola stampata di priorità bersaglio del contatore ferite: prima i ruoli di supporto, poi i corridori mobili dell’obiettivo, poi il danno — la minaccia decide dentro quell’ordine
uiTacticalAI.ordFocusBasisObjactor: attore dell'obiettivo — la priorità del bersaglio precede l'ordine dei ruoli del contatore e la minaccia; +1 secondo la regola stampata
uiTacticalAI.ordFocusBasisReaktion: retaliation for the shot on this figure
uiTacticalAI.ordFocusBasisWachzone: guard duty at the mission-critical object
uiTacticalAI.ordPhaseShiftQM: Time runs out: the Imperium leaves its defensive posture and hunts — round {0} of {1} on the mission clock.
uiTacticalAI.ordPhaseExplain: Phase: {0} -> {1} (mission clock in its final third).
uiTacticalAI.ordExplainWachzone: {0} is working at the mission-critical object in {1} — {2} acts first.
uiTacticalAI.ordExplainThreeC: {0} pushed into the newly activated section {1} — {2} reacts first.
uiTacticalAI.ordExplainVergeltung: {0} was shot at this round — {1} is suspected as the shooter.
uiTacticalAI.ordExplainSupportMaske: {0} trusts its picture of {1} and takes aim at the hero reported there.
uiTacticalAI.ordExplainSupportHalten: {0} holds its own section instead of guessing a target — the picture is still too diffuse.
uiTacticalAI.ordExplainClamp: A hero is working at the mission-critical object — the units guard the objective instead of hunting the heroes.
uiTacticalAI.apHeadAssault: ACTION POINTS: {0} — OF WHICH ATTACK POINTS: {1} (MULTIPLE ATTACKS PRINTED ON YOUR CARD)
uiTacticalAI.apRule: Read top-down: the first branch answered YES is executed.

uiTacticalAI.apTreeBlocker: ? Attack point available? Focus target within range + clear line of sight? → attack the focus target. No attack possible? → this point becomes movement: up to {0} spaces onto a blocking space between the mission objective and the focus target (no focus target? → toward the nearest hero). ? uiTacticalAI.apTreeSupport: ? Attack point available? Softest target shootable from cover (range + clear line of sight)? → attack it. No soft target? → attack the focus target if shootable. No attack possible? → this point becomes movement: step back into cover. ? Attack point(s) spent? Then this point is movement: step back into cover.
uiTacticalAI.apTreeAmbush: ? Attack point available? Ambush shot at the first hero you can shoot (range + clear line of sight)? → attack him. No attack possible? → this point becomes movement: up to {0} spaces into new cover. ? Attack point(s) spent? Then this point is movement: relocate to a space no hero can see (up to {0}) – your next shot comes from new cover.
uiTacticalAI.apTreeTripod: Your card's printed rule: movement and shooting exclude each other. ? Attack point available? Nearest hero within reach (range + clear line of sight)? → attack him. No target? → stay on your space. ? Movement strategically necessary? Then: reposition up to {0} spaces – but only if you do NOT want to attack directly afterwards: any movement forbids attacks this round.
uiTacticalAI.apTreeNoTarget: ? Attack point available? Nearest hero within range + clear line of sight? → attack him. No attack possible? → this point becomes movement: move up to {0} spaces toward the nearest hero. ? Attack point(s) spent? Then this point is movement: move up to {0} spaces toward the nearest hero – or move into cover.
uiTacticalAI.apEnd: ◆ ACTION POINT DONE — Points left? → Run the tree again from the top.
